# libertty +surface: the protocol from a shell script — query, a card with a
# button, and the click read back as JSON (one process group, as a script is:
# events go only to the program that drew the card).
type:libertty +surface query > /dev/null && echo QUERY-OK
key:enter
wait:2.0
expect:QUERY-OK
type:sh -c 'libertty +surface show cli --rows 3 --title CLI "[{\"type\":\"buttons\",\"items\":[{\"id\":\"yes\",\"label\":\"Yes\"}]}]" && libertty +surface read --timeout 10'
key:enter
wait:2.0
expect-surface:cli
expect-surface-text:cli=CLI
surface-press:cli=yes
wait:1.0
expect:"item":"yes"
expect-surface-live:cli=no
